from solution import check_String


def test_issue_example_thishasboth29():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is True for 'thishasboth29'."""
    assert check_String('thishasboth29') == True  # 11>=1 and 2>=1 => True


def test_issue_only_letters_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for letters only."""
    assert check_String('abcdef') == False  # 6>=1 and 0>=1 => False


def test_issue_only_digits_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for digits only."""
    assert check_String('123456') == False  # 0>=1 and 6>=1 => False


def test_issue_empty_string_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for empty string."""
    assert check_String('') == False  # 0>=1 and 0>=1 => False


def test_issue_minimal_mixed_is_true():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is True for 'a1'."""
    assert check_String('a1') == True  # 1>=1 and 1>=1 => True


def test_issue_single_letter_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for single letter."""
    assert check_String('q') == False  # 1>=1 and 0>=1 => False


def test_issue_single_digit_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for single digit."""
    assert check_String('7') == False  # 0>=1 and 1>=1 => False


def test_issue_uppercase_letter_counts_is_true():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' counts uppercase letter."""
    assert check_String('ABC9') == True  # 3>=1 and 1>=1 => True


def test_issue_symbols_only_is_false():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is False for symbols only."""
    assert check_String('!@#') == False  # 0>=1 and 0>=1 => False


def test_issue_mixed_with_symbols_is_true():
    """Check 'at least one letter and one number' is True for 'p!7'."""
    assert check_String('p!7') == True  # 1>=1 and 1>=1 => True


def test_contract_true_case_returns_bool():
    """Check documented '== True' means True case returns a bool."""
    result = check_String('a1')  # 1>=1 and 1>=1 => True
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # isinstance(True, bool) => True


def test_contract_false_case_returns_bool():
    """Check documented '== True' means False case still returns a bool."""
    result = check_String('abc')  # 3>=1 and 0>=1 => False
    assert isinstance(result, bool) == True  # isinstance(False, bool) => True
